scope: site-wide: genuinely shared across house + Desislava + unknown-author material, 2020-2026 practice preferred

conventions.language: Bulgarian; direct informative headline (typical 40-60 chars, 7-9 words), no colon / question / exclamation in headlines (0% in 2020-2026 bands).
conventions.numbers_dates: Digits in ~26-32% of recent headlines; body number-density ~11-16 per 1000 chars. Bulgarian date forms ('1-ви септември', '16-ти май') and clock forms ('12.30 ч.'). Ordinal '-ти/-ви' style is house-wide, not author-specific.
conventions.local_specificity: Every group carries Burgas-region anchors (median 1-3 local-name hits per article); institution naming is formal-full ('Областна дирекция на МВР в Бургас', 'Регионален исторически музей - Бургас', 'Община Камено').
conventions.quotation: Quoted speech stays inline in body (structured blockquote count is 0 across all 150); quote-mark density ~5-8 per 1000 chars; attribution verbs (съобщиха, каза, заяви).
conventions.structure: No structural lead/subheadline element anywhere in the corpus (subheadline None in 150/150). Caption + tags are CMS-level metadata, not style: caption present ~89-100% everywhere, tags ~2.5-5.6 everywhere - do NOT treat as voice.
conventions.headline_opening: Headline states the news fact directly; body normally opens with the same fact expanded (immediate_fact 68-70% overall) - never a delayed literary lede.

evidence_notes: hl colon/?/! = 0% in bands 2020-2023 (n=35) and 2024-2026 (n=60); structured quotes 0/150; subheadline None 150/150; caption 89-100% in every group; local-name hits median >=1 in every group.
